newsitem.title: UK: UK Oftel sets Fair Trading Condition on more firms.
newsitem.headline: UK Oftel sets Fair Trading Condition on more firms.

text.p: Britain's Office of Telecommunications (Oftel) said on Monday it planned to apply its Fair Trading Condition -- which prohibits operators from abusing a dominant market position -- to the licences of over 350 telecommunication operators.
Oftel said the Fair Trading Condition already applied to 45 international licences, including those of British Telecommunications Plc and Mercury, a division of Cable & Wireless Plc.
The condition prohibits agreements which restrict competition.

"It is essential that Oftel has the ability to deal effectively with anti-competitive behaviour wherever and whenever it may arise. The Fair Trading Condition helps us achieve this," Don Cruickshank, director general of telecommunications, said in a statement.
